summary: Iteration 218 — Frontend-only verification of TWO bug fixes in SB Drive VTC. PRIORITY (CLIENT no-driver popup): PASS end-to-end. Registered fresh client test_iter218_1781034264@demo.sb, deep-linked to /course?mode=bidding with Paris Tour Eiffel → Gare du Nord pre-fill, clicked 'Proposer mon tarif' (ride-choose-request-btn) → landed on /taxi-bidding, clicked 'Trouver un chauffeur' (find-driver-btn) → bid published (ride_9116dc54d96d). Captured the rideId via Playwright request interception then POST /api/rides/{id}/status {status:'cancelled', cancel_reason:'test'} (raw API, NOT on-screen cancel). Within the next poll cycle (~3s) the [data-testid=no-driver-modal] appeared with title 'Aucun chauffeur trouvé' and all three CTAs present: [data-testid=no-driver-retry-btn] (Réessayer), [data-testid=no-driver-schedule-btn] (Planifier le trajet), [data-testid=no-driver-dismiss-btn] (Annuler). Clicking 'Planifier le trajet' navigated to /course?mode=book_later&plat=48.8584&plng=2.2945&paddr=Tour+Eiffel&dlat=48.8809&dlng=2.3553&daddr=Gare+du+Nord and the 'Programmer la course' calendar modal auto-opened with addresses pre-filled. NEGATIVE case verified: when the user clicks the on-screen 'Annuler la recherche' (cancel-btn), userCancelledRef is set, the ride is cancelled, and the no-driver-modal does NOT appear — UI returns to the fare picker. DRIVER auto-close (secondary, code review only): logic correctly implemented in /app/frontend/src/pages/driver/DriverHome.js — useRef renewCountRef, graceMs=10000 default (0 after 2 renewals), useEffect schedules close at offer-expiry+grace, toast 'Aucune réponse du client. Retour en ligne.' fires and clears myOffer + incomingRequest. Per the brief, the ~45s timing wait was not executed under playwright; logic is verified by code review and matches the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: TaxiBiddingPage.js L249-253 correctly distinguishes system-cancel (no driver) vs user-cancel via userCancelledRef. The ref is reset to false in handleSubmit (L180) and set to true in cancelSearch (L369). Modal only shows when ride.status === 'cancelled' AND userCancelledRef.current === false (L252). Logic is sound.

scheduleTrip (L296-303) correctly URL-encodes plat/plng/paddr+dlat/dlng/daddr and navigates to /course?mode=book_later. Confirmed in test — URL after click: /course?mode=book_later&plat=48.8584&plng=2.2945&paddr=Tour+Eiffel&dlat=48.8809&dlng=2.3553&daddr=Gare+du+Nord.
retrySearch (L292-295) resets noDriver + expired + searchSeconds and re-invokes handleSubmit (not exercised in this iteration, code-reviewed only).

DriverHome.js L41/L361-365/L422/L436/L441 — renewCountRef + graceMs logic is in place: 10s grace by default, 0 after 2 renewals, toast 'Aucune réponse du client. Retour en ligne.' on auto-close. Not exercised under playwright (timing test would require ~45s of real waiting + a real driver session with a server-side-created bidding ride); logic verified by code review and matches the spec from the brief.
Minor: a single 401 console error was observed at the start of the run (likely /api/auth/me before login completed). Non-blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PRIORITY methodology that works end-to-end for the CLIENT no-driver popup: (1) Register a fresh user via POST /api/auth/register with body {email, password, name, role:'user', phone} — note the schema requires 'name' (NOT first_name/last_name). (2) Login via POST /api/auth/login (sets HttpOnly cookie via credentials:'include'). (3) page.goto(`/course?mode=bidding&plat=48.8584&plng=2.2945&paddr=Tour%20Eiffel&dlat=48.8809&dlng=2.3553&daddr=Gare%20du%20Nord`) → wait 5s. (4) Click [data-testid=ride-choose-request-btn] (Proposer mon tarif). (5) On /taxi-bidding page, click [data-testid=find-driver-btn] (Trouver un chauffeur). (6) To capture rideId, attach a page.on('request') listener BEFORE clicking find-driver-btn and parse /api/rides/(ride_[a-f0-9]+) from polling URLs (the page polls /api/rides/{searching} every 2.5s). (7) POST `/api/rides/{rideId}/status` with body `{status:'cancelled', cancel_reason:'test'}` and credentials:'include'. (8) Wait ~4.5s (one poll cycle + buffer) → [data-testid=no-driver-modal] becomes visible. (9) Click [data-testid=no-driver-schedule-btn] → URL changes to /course?mode=book_later with all addr query params preserved. NEGATIVE-case methodology: same setup through step (5), then click 'Annuler la recherche' on-screen (text-based locator or [data-testid=cancel-btn]) → page returns to fare picker; modal must NOT appear. For DRIVER auto-close: log in as jean.dupont@demo.sb / Driver123!, ensure driver_b366adb552eb has no active ride first (cancel any pending). Set ONLINE. From a client session create a bidding ride. Driver sheet appears → send a counter-offer (or accept). Wait 40-45s without renewing → modal must auto-close; verify [data-testid=incoming-request-modal] is gone and the driver-home map is shown. Timing wait was not executed under playwright in this iteration.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (CLIENT silent close) — root cause was that the bidding page handled the cancelled status by simply unmounting the searching state, with no visible feedback when the server cancelled the ride (no driver / timeout). Fix in TaxiBiddingPage.js: added noDriver state + userCancelledRef to distinguish system-cancel from user-cancel; modal markup with the three testids and prefilled scheduleTrip navigation to /course?mode=book_later. Verified end-to-end. Bug 2 (DRIVER stuck sheet) — root cause was no client-side timeout on an offer sent to a non-responsive client; the incoming-request-modal stayed open. Fix in DriverHome.js: renewCountRef + useEffect on [myOffer] computes graceMs (10s, or 0 after 2 renewals), schedules auto-close at offer-expiry+grace, clears myOffer/incomingRequest, fires toast 'Aucune réponse du client. Retour en ligne.'. Verified by code review only; timing test deferred.
